instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Swedish tweet express or imply, including through what they choose to share: positive, neutral, or negative?
instructions.rule: Judge the poster's stance, including what they share. Mockery, insults, sarcasm, complaints, exposing wrongdoing, and criticising opponents, policies or society are negative even in a calm tone. Good news, warm remarks and enthusiastic promotion or invitations ('Kom!', 'Skriv på!') are positive. Neutral covers uncommented headlines and alerts, advocating one's own proposal, slogans, predictions, plain listings and ads, fan requests, check-ins, automatic posts, everyday questions and calm corrections.

neutral.what: Uncommented headlines and alerts, advocacy of one's own proposal, slogans, predictions, plain listings, ads, fan requests, check-ins, automatic posts, everyday questions and calm corrections.
examples: Tvärbanan: Stopp mellan Alvik-Solna pga. olycka. (Tvärbanan: stop between Alvik and Solna due to an accident.)

Högre lärartäthet, av utbildade lärare idag. Det krävs för att bryta det långvariga kunskapstappet! #Alliansen #svpol #jobbvalet (More trained teachers per pupil today. That is needed to break the long knowledge decline!)
@CarlssonJhannes Absolut. Jag förstår den ståndpunkten och respekterar den med. (Absolutely. I understand that position and respect it too.)
neutral.cues: headline + link, krävs (is needed), tror/tvivlar (think/doubt), vad/hur/när (what/how/when), Jag gillade ett videoklipp (I liked a video)
neutral.not_for: Questioning or faulting an opponent's policy, or a headline with the poster's angry or sad comment, is negative.

positive.what: Joy, praise, love, gratitude, excitement, warm teasing; good news and successes the poster endorses; enthusiastic promotion of events, shows or campaigns.
examples: Gratis böcker på föreläsningen http://t.co/DClFqxjJIY (Free books at the lecture)
RT @chkvi: Ikväll sparkar EM-kvalet igång! Jag och @JArneng kör Danmark-Armenien kl 18.00 på @kanal9sverige (Tonight the Euro qualifiers kick off! Me and @JArneng do Denmark-Armenia at 18.00)
@papperferdinand grattis till ert giftemål det var ett vackert bröllop :,) (congrats on your marriage, it was a beautiful wedding)
positive.cues: grattis (congrats), gratis (free), kom! (come!), bästa (best), härligt (lovely), älskar (love), !, :), <3, haha
positive.not_for: Ironic praise ('Tur att...', Lucky that...) is negative. 'Jag gillade ett videoklipp' (I liked a video), 'snälla följ mig' (please follow me) and plain listings are neutral.

negative.what: Anger, sadness, frustration, complaints, insults, mockery, sarcasm, criticism of politicians, parties, policies or society, and sharing scandals.
examples: RT @gustavgelin: Just nu röstar Sveriges Riksdag in en rasist, fascist och homfob till en vice talmanspost. (Right now the Riksdag is voting a racist, fascist and homophobe into a deputy speaker post.)

Väldigt många som röstar rött är för ROT men mot RUT, beror det på könsfördelningen inom ROT och RUT? Att man vill stoppa kvinnors företag? (Many red voters favour ROT but oppose RUT, is it the gender split? That they want to stop women's businesses?)
Livet e hårt och sen dör man (Life is hard and then you die)
negative.not_for: Swearing used for enthusiasm ('SÅ. JÄVLA. BRA', SO. DAMN. GOOD) is positive. Teasing friends with haha or ;) is usually positive.
